test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian cueists won his eighth title at the 19th Asian 100 UP Billiards Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is** '****Pankaj Advani'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Advani **is an Indian** Billiards player** who has won 17 World Billiards titles.
 
• He has also won the International Billiards and Snooker Federation **(IBSF) World Champion** title **25 times**.
 
• Pankaj Advani is the** Indian cueist** who won his eighth title at the **19****th Asian 100 UP Billiards Championship 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian cueist, **Wilson Jones** was the first Asian to win the **World Billiards Championship** title.
 
• **Alok Kumar** won the** 2011 Asian Billiards Championship** and was the runner-up of the **2013 World Billiards Championship**.
 
• **Dhruv Sitwala**, an Indian cueist, won the** Asian Billiards Championship** twice in 2015 and 2016.
